card.name: Capitalized words split before the letter I
card.fires_on: The piece just before a capital I in all-caps medical words, such as CARD before IORESPIRATORY, ES before IA, or MULT before ITRACE. It appears mostly in boxed-warning headings and capitalized headings.

modes.label: CARD before IO
modes.description: The CARD piece of all-caps cardio- words in warning headings.
modes.example: RISK OF ACUTE<< CARD>>IORESPIRATORY FAILURE IN SUS

modes.label: Anesthesia and similar
modes.description: The ES piece of ANESTHESIA, followed by IA.
modes.example: IAC ARREST WITH USE OF BUPIVACAINE HYDROCHLORIDE INJECTION IN OBSTETRICAL ANESTH<<ES>>IA There have been reports of cardiac arrest

modes.label: MULT brand names
modes.description: The MULT piece of multi-vitamin or multi-trace product names, followed by I.

card.writes: It boosts the capital letter I as the next piece and suppresses lowercase i, which fits all-caps text.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalized words when the next letter is I, as in CARDIORESPIRATORY or ANESTHESIA.
